---
name: Map data issue
about: Report a missing or incorrect feature at a specific location
---

**Location and feature** — longitude, latitude, OSM object link or ID, affected tile, dataset date and source.

**Observed appearance** — include the camera, style, filter and whether the property is observed, derived or inferred.

**Expected appearance** — identify the source tags or rule that explain the difference. Include a small reproducer where possible.
